title: Circuit Digitization: hand-drawn schematics to structural circuit netlists with an endpoint-graph wire join and a human-verified connectivity benchmark
description: Software and benchmarks for recovering structural circuit netlists (which component terminals share an electrical node) from hand-drawn schematics: an OBB component detector, an occlusion-first wire extractor, and an endpoint-graph join with degree-budget completion. Release 1.1.0 accompanies the revised IEEE Access manuscript (Access-2026-33821) and includes the 31-image human-verified connectivity benchmark (labels corrected 2026-10-05: plain crossings are not connections), the 164-image held-out benchmark with reference nets derived from CGHD v12 annotations, a 40-draw human audit of that reference, paired-test, rescaling, ablation and end-to-end evaluation scripts, synthetic-circuit generation and a VLM connectivity harness. The evaluation uses annotated component boxes unless stated; it does not establish pin identity, component values or simulation equivalence. Our source code and own annotations are released under MIT; material derived from CGHD-1152 (ground_truth/net_gt_ui_overlays/, ground_truth/component_labels/) remains under CC BY 4.0; reference nets derived from CGHD v12 annotations (ground_truth/cghd_ref/, ground_truth/cghd_ref_audit/) are released under CC BY-SA 4.0. See LICENSE.txt and ground_truth/LICENSE.
